# The Technology Framework

> A named Head of IT for UK firms that have outgrown tickets. A standalone practice.

- Official site: https://www.thetechnologyframework.com/

The Technology Framework is not an MSP and does not sell a helpdesk. Clients keep their MSP if it works. We sit above it. One named senior, one or two days a week.

## Offers

- [Fractional Head of IT](https://www.thetechnologyframework.com/fractional-head-of-it/): the seat on the leadership team
- [Cyber Essentials Plus and ISO 27001](https://www.thetechnologyframework.com/cyber-essentials-iso-27001/): we implement the controls; an accredited assessor certifies
- [Microsoft Copilot readiness](https://www.thetechnologyframework.com/microsoft-copilot-readiness/): tenant first, then a 30-day pilot on the seats you actually need
- [Azure FinOps](https://www.thetechnologyframework.com/azure-finops/): only when the Azure or cloud bill is over £10k a month
- [One production IT agent](https://www.thetechnologyframework.com/production-it-agent/): one workflow, one KPI, then we stop

PE carve-out / Day-1 is a named project, not a sixth offer: https://www.thetechnologyframework.com/pe-carve-out-it/
